html:
I just wanted to put together a really quick blog post, slash announcement about all coffee deliveries this December.

Here at Strangers we tend to use Royal Mail for small packages and Parcel Force for our larger orders.

Now, normally both of these services are pretty good for a speedy delivery but as everyone knows there are on going strike days occurring at Royal Mail which is causing massive issues on delivery times.

We are looking for an alternative, reliable, affordable service to replace the Royal Mail service we offer but of course this is easier said than done.

In the meantime we recommend all Strangers customers, retail and wholesale, place their coffee orders with us as early as possible this December to ensure their products arrive in time for Christmas.

We really are sorry for the inconvenience that Royal Mail are bringing at this time, we hope they gain resolution to their problems soon.

Anyway until next time, happy brewing. Peace. ✌️
